brief: The canvas presents a dynamic, cross-sectional view of a combustion engine's core mechanisms. Viewers observe multiple pistons moving rhythmically within their cylinders. The cycle is continuous: colored fluids visibly flow into and out of the chambers through actuated intake and exhaust valves, timed with the movement of the connecting rods. The movement culminates in a simulated spark explosion, which pushes the pistons downward, transferring kinetic energy through connecting rods to turn the visible transaxle and connected gears.

statement: This sketch visualizes a dynamic combustion engine with four pistons moving rhythmically within their cylinders. The pistons oscillate vertically while fluid flows in and out through actuated intake valves timed with connecting rods. A spark explosion effect is simulated as pistons reach their peak, pushing the system downward and transferring kinetic energy to a visible transaxle and connected gears that rotate in response. The scene uses WebGL rendering for 3D depth and motion, with each component moving independently to create an immersive mechanical simulation.
